heading: Unit Mix, Sizes & Price Trends — Serro at The Heights
subtitle: Official brochure data with independent market context.
pricing_note: Pricing for 4- and 5-bedroom units has not been released as of February 2026. Emaar typically stages releases, with premium unit pricing following initial sell-through of 3-bedroom inventory. Based on comparable Emaar villa projects, 4-bedroom units are expected to launch at AED 7.5–8.5M, with 5-bedroom units exceeding AED 10M.

price_commentary.intro: The AED 6,000,000 entry price for 3-bedroom villas reflects Emaar's strategy of establishing a pricing floor with initial releases. Two factors explain the positioning:

factors.title: Master Infrastructure Premium
factors.content: The Heights includes significant upfront investment in wellness infrastructure (lakes, tracks, clubhouse) that is priced into early phases.

factors.title: Al Yalayis Location Premium vs. Discount
factors.content: At AED 1,732/sqft, Serro sits approximately 18% below Dubai Hills' comparable product but 15% above Emaar South's villa pricing (AED 1,400–1,500/sqft). This reflects The Heights' positioning as a premium wellness enclave rather than a commuter-focused community.

floor_plan_intro: Serro villas follow a consistent architectural language across all three typologies:

floor_plans.title: 3-Bedroom Configuration
floor_plans.description: Ground floor features open-plan living/dining (approx. 1,500 sqft) with guest bedroom and powder room; first floor contains three ensuite bedrooms, master with dressing area. Total covered terrace space averages 107 sqft.

floor_plans.title: 4-Bedroom Configuration
floor_plans.description: Adds a second floor with additional family lounge and fourth ensuite bedroom. Plot sizes increase to 5,177–5,236 sqft, allowing for larger private gardens.

floor_plans.title: 5-Bedroom Configuration
floor_plans.description: Full three-storey layout with roof terrace access; ground floor includes staff quarters. Total built-up area approaches 5,800 sqft with 7,000+ sqft plots.

distinguishing_feature_cards.title: Aesthetic
distinguishing_feature_cards.text: Mediterranean-contemporary aesthetic with whitewashed finishes, curved architectural elements, and terracotta accents.

distinguishing_feature_cards.title: Glazing
distinguishing_feature_cards.text: Floor-to-ceiling glazing maximising natural light and garden connectivity.

distinguishing_feature_cards.title: Materials
distinguishing_feature_cards.text: Neutral material palette (beige stone, warm timber accents) designed for longevity.

distinguishing_feature_cards.title: Carport
distinguishing_feature_cards.text: All villas include covered carports (494 - 739 sqft depending on typology).

insider_tip: The 3-bedroom Type A (3,463 sqft) and Type C (3,340 sqft) differ primarily in ground floor layout — Type C sacrifices some living area for a larger private garden. Buyers prioritising outdoor space should target Type C, despite the marginally smaller footprint.
